= 5000

Number of people who do not like any cold drink = 0.2 x 5000 = 1000

The following pie chart shows the degree distribution of number of marbles five children named as A, B, C, D and E have.

B lost 20% of his total marbles, D lost 30% of his total marbles, and E, lost 1/4th of his total marbles. C bought 25% more than his total marbles and A gave 40% of his total marbles to E. If D lost 2/5th of his remaining marbles, then the central angle (to the nearest degree) of the sector corresponding to child C in the pie chart will become:
questions.solution_en:
Let the total number of marbles all children together have initially = 360

Number of marbles A has after giving 40% to E = 90 * 60/100 = 54

Number of marbles B has after losing 20% of his total marbles = 60 * 80/100 = 48

Number of marbles C has after buying 25% more = 80 * 125/100 = 100

Number of marbles D has after losing 30% of his total = 50 * 70/100 = 35

Number of marbles D has after losing 2/5th of 35 = 35 * 3/5 = 21

Number of marbles E has after losing 1/4th of his total = 80 * 3/4 = 60

Number of marbles E has after receiving 36 marbles from A = 60 + 36 = 96

Required angle = 100 * 360/319 = 112.8 = 113°

questions.q_en:

Following pie-chart represents the percentage break-up of sales of watches in a store from Monday to Saturday.

Total sale of watches in the store from Monday to Sunday = 13880

If 2880 watches sold on Sunday, then what is the difference between the average sale of watches from Monday to Tuesday and the average sale of watches from Thursday to Saturday?
questions.solution_en:
Sale of watches on Sunday = 2880

Then, sale of watches from Monday to Saturday = 13880 - 2880 = 11000

Average sale of watches from Monday to Tuesday = (14% of 11000 + 10% of 11000)/2 = 1320

Average sale of watches from Thursday to Saturday = (16% of 11000 + 12% of 11000 + 20% of 11000)/3 = 1760

Therefore, difference = 1760 - 1320 = 440
